meta.method: Evidence curator audit. Fetched PubMed abstracts (NCBI efetch) for every cited paper and for new candidate papers found by PubMed title search; fetched PMC full-text HTML where open (PMC509193 Vattem 2004, PMC3064149 Palam 2011, PMC4764583 Floor 2016 via efetch XML, PMC2652341, PMC1888809, PMC1447409, PMC1299076, PMC109205, PMC1456917, PMC363665, PMC11446271). Quotes are verbatim (<=15 words) from the text actually fetched; quote_source says abstract or full text. Cell lines marked 'full text' were read from the article; 'most-mentioned line' means identified by counting mentions, not by reading the specific assay. Anything not read is 'unverified'. Tier A = direct experiment on that gene's 5' leader with uORF or leader-isoform resolution; B = experiment on the leader but not resolving the isoforms/uORFs the app compares (incl. IRES-only studies) or genome-wide data only (Cao 2021 TE); C = none found. show_as_example = whether the app's isoform-level presentation for that gene is backed by the paper with a verified transcript mapping; false means show gene-level text at most. No data in utr_data.json was edited.
meta.tiers: A: direct leader experiment with uORF/isoform resolution; B: leader tested without the resolution the app needs, or genome-wide only; C: none

assays: luciferase reporter (ATF4 leader-Luc) with uORF start-codon mutations
ATF4.cells: mouse embryonic fibroblasts, eIF2alpha S/S vs A/A (full text)
ATF4.quote: when uORF2 was mutated there was a ≈35-fold increase in ATF4-Luc
ATF4.caveat: Paper tested the MOUSE ATF4 leader; human ATF4-206 (MANE) has the same uORF1 (3 aa) / uORF2 (59 aa, overlapping CDS) layout the paper describes for human and mouse, plus an extra 1-codon uORF at nt 24 the paper does not discuss. Only the MANE leader corresponds to the tested leader; the other 5 ATF4 isoforms have no experimental data (ATF4-201 has a Cao TE value but it is flagged ambiguous).

ATF5.cells: unverified (not in abstract; full text not fetched)
ATF5.quote: Mutation of uAUG2 in the uORF2 of 5'-UTRalpha restored the basal expression
ATF5.caveat: Ensembl isoforms not mapped to 5'-UTRalpha / 5'-UTRbeta (exon1alpha/exon1beta) - ATF5-201 has a uORF1(3 aa)+overlapping uORF2 layout consistent with 5'-UTRalpha but this was not verified against the paper's sequence. Show gene-level only; no isoform-pair claim. Species of the tested leaders not stated in abstract (unverified).

assays: luciferase reporter (CHOP leader-Luc) with uORF ATG1/ATG2 mutations, Kozak substitution, uORF truncation
DDIT3.quote: eIF2 phosphorylation induces preferential translation of CHOP by a mechanism involving a single upstream ORF
DDIT3.caveat: Paper used the mouse CHOP leader (TSS mapped by 5'-RACE in MEF). Its single 34-aa uORF has two in-frame AUGs (AUG1, AUG2); the app lists these as two uORFs (34 aa and 31 aa) in DDIT3-201 - that is one uORF with two starts. DDIT3-201 also has a 73-aa ORF overlapping the CDS that the paper does not describe. Other DDIT3 isoforms: no experimental data.

PPP1R15A.cells: HepG2 (most-mentioned line in full text PMC2652341; specific assay-cell pairing not checked)
PPP1R15A.quote: the downstream uORF mediates repression of basal translation and directs translation during eIF2alpha phosphorylation
PPP1R15A.caveat: NEW source (not yet in meta.sources / gene blurb is empty). Human GADD34 5'UTR has two non-overlapping uORFs, matching PPP1R15A-201 (22 aa and 26 aa uORFs). Other isoforms (-205, -208 with overlapping ORFs) have no experimental data.

BACE1.cells: HeLa (Mihailovich, full text); HEK293, N2a (Zhou & Song, full text); HEK293, COS7, H4 (Lammich, abstract)
BACE1.quote: mutations of all four uAUGs fully de-repress translation
BACE1.caveat: NEW sources. Evidence is uAUG-resolved on the full-length leader, NOT on alternative leaders. Mihailovich 2007: 'in brain and pancreas, almost all of the native BACE1 mRNA contains the full-length 5' UTR' - so the short Ensembl leaders (BACE1-206 26 nt, -202 89 nt, -207 67 nt) should not be presented as naturally competing isoforms. Papers disagree on uAUG count/which is key (four uAUGs, second most inhibitory - Mihailovich; six uAUGs, fourth inhibitory - Zhou & Song).

MYC.quote: An IRES was identified, requiring elements located within the P2 leader
MYC.caveat: NEW source. Mechanism is IRES/cap-independent, which the scanning model does not have. MANE MYC-206 main start is a CUG (context UAGACG CUG G = c-Myc1), while the other 5 isoforms are annotated at AUG starts (c-Myc2) - so isoform comparisons mix different protein N-termini and a non-AUG start the AUG-based Kozak parameters do not cover. Ensembl leaders not mapped to P0/P1/P2. No Cao 2021 TE values. Do not use as an example.

VEGFA.cells: COS-7 (most-mentioned line in full text PMC109205)
VEGFA.quote: two independent internal ribosome entry sites (IRESs) are present in this 5' UTR
VEGFA.caveat: NEW source. IRES mechanism, outside the model. MANE VEGFA-226 is annotated at a CUG start (GUCGCG CUG A); VEGFA-201/-206 start at AUG -> different protein N-termini, not same-protein leader comparisons. VEGFA-206 (1036 nt) is close to the paper's 1,038-nt UTR but not verified identical. Cao TE values exist for -201/-206 only (gene-level, B).

TP53.quote: two internal ribosome entry sites (IRESs) mediate the translation of both full-length and DeltaN-p53 isoforms
TP53.caveat: NEW source. Evidence concerns IRESs for full-length vs DeltaN-p53 from one mRNA, not alternative 5' leaders. TP53-221/-228 use a different annotated start codon (different protein). Only TP53-201 has Cao TE, flagged ambiguous. Do not use as a leader-isoform example.

assays: polysome loading of endogenous L-/S-mdm2 mRNA
reporter gene fused to each 5' leader
MDM2.quote: this mRNA was loaded with ribosomes inefficiently in comparison with S-mdm2
MDM2.caveat: MANE MDM2-202 is annotated at a different start codon (exon-1 AUG, CCCCGG AUG G) than the P2 transcripts (AGGCAA AUG U) -> not a same-protein comparator for S-mdm2; use the mdm2_p2 pair (224 vs 209) only. MDM2-209 leader ends ...CCCCGGAUGGUGAGG..., i.e. it reads through the exon-1 AUG + what looks like the splice donor, so it is an approximation of the spliced L-mdm2 leader (its two 14-aa uORFs match 'two uORFs'); exact identity unverified. Landers 1997 (abstract) independently reports the P2-promoter transcripts have 'significantly enhanced translational efficiency'.

BRCA1.cells: unverified (not in abstract; full text not retrieved)
BRCA1.quote: translation efficiency of transcripts containing 5'-UTRb is 10 times lower than those containing 5'-UTRa
BRCA1.caveat: Literature is isoform-resolved, but 5'-UTRa/5'-UTRb are NOT mapped to Ensembl transcripts (no coordinates/sequence in abstract; truncated-Alu-containing isoform not identified). Show the blurb gene-level only; do not present any BRCA1 isoform pair as the paper's comparison.

ERBB2.cells: primary human fibroblasts, human mammary epithelial cells, BT474, MCF-7, COS-7 (abstract)
ERBB2.quote: HER-2 transcript leader repressed downstream translation approximately five-fold in both primary and transformed cells
ERBB2.caveat: Paper found ONE leader (no difference between cell types) with one short uORF; matches ERBB2-201 (single 6-aa uORF). The long alternative leaders (ERBB2-214/-217/-203 with 18-23 uORFs) have no dedicated experimental data; only Cao TE (gene-level, -217/-203 ambiguous).

assays: reporter assays of human and mouse ER-alpha 5'-UTR variants
ESR1.quote: Some of the 5'-UTRs were found to strongly inhibit translation
ESR1.caveat: Ensembl ESR1 isoforms not mapped to the paper's promoter-specific 5'-UTR variants; abstract does not say which leaders inhibit most. Gene-level example only; no isoform-pair direction. No Cao 2021 TE values for ESR1.

RICTOR.quote: differ by only nine nucleotides, yet still exhibit differential protein production
RICTOR.caveat: The paper's two leaders differ by 9 nt; Ensembl RICTOR-202 (22 nt) vs -209 (167 nt) do not correspond. Paper attributes it 'possibly' to cap-proximal structure (RNAfold prediction, not measured). Do not show RICTOR isoforms as the paper's pair. Cao TE values exist (PC3: 5.25 vs 21.9, HEK293T 1.25 vs 0.88 - cell types disagree in direction).

SRSF5.quote: Both 5′ leaders from SRSF5 contain two uORFs
SRSF5.caveat: Paper names SRSF5-002/-005 (old Havana names), not mapped to current ENST ids; text does not state which leader is translated better. Cao TE for -217 and -203 are identical (ambiguous, reads not resolved). Gene-level mention only.

CCNE2.quote: The two tested CCNE2 isoforms differ in both the 5′ and 3′ UTRs
CCNE2.caveat: Not 5'-leader-resolved (5' and 3' UTRs changed together; authors only say control is 'possible' via the 5' UTR). Cao TE for -201/-205 identical (ambiguous). Do not present as a 5' leader example.

bulk.quote: Thapsigargin treatment of MEF cells significantly reduced polysome levels
bulk.note: Direction supported (global polysome reduction under eIF2-P; abstract: 'phosphorylation of eIF2 rapidly reduces protein synthesis'). BUT findings.js cite field is 'eIF2α-P general repression', which is not a source key -> should be 'palam2011'. The pass threshold (median stress/calm < 0.6 over our isoforms) is not a number from any paper; label it as an assumed threshold.

atf4_up.quote: expression of the ATF4-luciferase was increased 6-fold in MEF cells
atf4_up.figure: Vattem & Wek 2004 Fig. 2 (thapsigargin, eIF2alpha S/S MEF)
atf4_up.note: Mouse ATF4 leader. Induction absent in eIF2alpha S51A (A/A) cells. App threshold (>1.5x) is weaker than the reported 6-fold; fine as a direction check.

atf4_u1.quote: Mutation of uORF1 resulted in a severe reduction in ATF4-Luc expression
atf4_u1.note: Paper: reduction 'independent of stress', comparable to A/A cells -> loss of induction, as tested. The test disables uORFs with 1<aa<=5, which in ATF4-206 is the 3-aa uORF1 only (the extra 1-codon uORF at nt 24 is untouched).

atf4_u2.quote: when uORF2 was mutated there was a ≈35-fold increase in ATF4-Luc
atf4_u2.note: Compared with nonstressed WT; test requires >3x basal, consistent.

chop_up.quote: CHOP-Luc expression was increased by 3-fold in the wild-type MEF cells
chop_up.figure: Palam 2011 Fig. 3C (reporter); Fig. 2 polysome shift 25% -> 52% in large polysomes
chop_up.note: Direction supported. But the app's 'missing mechanism' note and params.js SOURCES.palam2011 text ('CHOP uORF elongation stall controls stress induction') misstate the paper: the paper's central mechanism for INDUCTION is bypass of the uORF 'due to its poor start site context' under eIF2-P (leaky scanning, Fig. 6). The elongation/termination block is 'suggested' to explain why the uORF is inhibitory (Fig. 7), not the induction. Reword: induction = leaky-scanning bypass of a poor-context uORF; uORF inhibition possibly via a translation elongation/termination block.

mdm2_p2.quote: this mRNA was loaded with ribosomes inefficiently in comparison with S-mdm2
mdm2_p2.figure: unverified (abstract only; full text not retrieved)
mdm2_p2.note: Direction (S-mdm2/P2 > L-mdm2/P1) supported by Brown 1999 and Landers 1997 abstracts. Mapping caveats: MDM2-224 (89 nt, P2 first exon) is a reasonable S-mdm2 match; MDM2-209 is an approximation of L-mdm2 (reads through the exon-1 AUG/splice donor; contains an upstream in-frame AUG the model treats as an in-frame extension). Endogenous Cao 2021 TE does not clearly reproduce it (HEK293T 0.60 vs 0.56 with 209 flagged ambiguous; PC3 1.46 vs 1.75, opposite).

new_sources.note: Verifies params.js kozak1991 qualitatively: first-AUG yield decreased progressively as cap distance fell from 32 to 3 nt (in vitro). The app's capAUGnt=12 is not a number from this abstract -> keep labelled as a choice.

param_sources_check.kozak1989: verified (abstract on PMC363665): -30 kcal/mol hairpin 12 nt from cap blocked 40S engagement, no effect at 52 nt; -61 kcal/mol hp7 at 72 nt stalled 40S. Matches SOURCES text.
param_sources_check.wang2022: verified (PubMed abstract): yeast 43S scanning ~100 nt/s, single-molecule fluorescence. SOURCES says smFRET; abstract says 'real-time single-molecule fluorescence spectroscopy' (full text of PMC11446271 calls it a smFRET study) - OK.
param_sources_check.scan10: verified (full text PMC11446271): yeast scanning complexes 'scan diverse mRNA leaders at a rate of 10 to 20 nt s-1'.
param_sources_check.kozak1991: verified qualitatively (see new_sources); SOURCES text still says '(verify)' and url null -> can add url and drop 'verify'.
param_sources_check.palam2011: TEXT MISSTATES the paper - see findings.chop_up.note.

other_flags: Non-AUG main starts: MANE MYC-206 (CUG) and MANE VEGFA-226 (CUG). main_kozak and the sim's Kozak P(init) are AUG rules; do not show these as scanning examples.

Isoforms whose annotated start codon differs from the reference (tss_note features alt_start_codon) encode different N-termini - in MYC, VEGFA, TP53, MDM2 (MANE vs P2) - so the comparison is not 'same protein, different leader'.

Most non-reference isoforms of every gene have NO experimental data; their numbers in the app are model output (Optimus/ridge/sim) only. Only the gene-level leaders in the papers and the mdm2_p2 pair are experimentally backed.
Cao 2021 TE values with ambiguous=true are gene-level (identical across isoforms) and should not be shown as isoform differences.
